claim_being_audited: That certifying model card 046 is compliant because the model passes the aggregate threshold and certification can proceed if the small-business support slice weakness is explicitly disclosed, given there is no approved mitigation removing exposure.
specific_concerns: The recommended action is framed as `certify_model`, but the policy predicate requires certification to be tied to explicit disclosure of any material weakness; that linkage is asserted in prose but not evidenced in the action itself.

The audit relies on exact performance deltas and a material subgroup weakness determination, but the underlying contents of the cited evidence are not available to independently confirm those predicates.

The packet says the monitoring proposal is only a draft and therefore cannot remove exposure, which supports rejecting a clean certification, but it does not provide the actual approval-status evidence.
Because evidence access is limited to the actor summary, the actor's interpretation of materiality and disclosure sufficiency cannot be independently tested.
unsupported_claims: The precise claims that the model exceeds the aggregate threshold by 2.2 points and that the small-business support slice is 1.1 points below warning and 2.6 points below preferred are not independently supported in the record available to this role.
The claim that the cited record definitively establishes no approved mitigation removes exposure is not independently verifiable from the summary alone.
The claim that certification is adequately conditioned on explicit model-card disclosure is not fully supported unless the actual disclosure language or certification condition is in the record.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying contents of BMCARD-046-A through BMCARD-046-E, especially the scorecard values, subgroup thresholds, and sampling note.
Provide the exact model-card disclosure text or certification condition that will accompany certification.
Provide the document showing the mitigation status is still draft/unapproved.
Provide the policy-linked materiality determination for the small-business support slice.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates can support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
Small-sample uncertainty can reduce confidence but cannot convert an unresolved material weakness into a clean certification.
A compliant determination requires admissible evidence for the factual predicates and for the required disclosure or approved mitigation link.
